name: Duette 2
source: A Doujin title by Stage-nana of Kanon. Nayuki Minase meets a mysterious girl in the shopping district. Her name is Ayu Tsukimiya and shes looking for something precious, but doesn't quite know what it is. This is the story of the developing bond between the two.
translation: Kanon的Stage-nana的同人作品。水濑奈雪在商店街遇见了神秘的女孩。她的名字叫月宫亚由，她正在寻找一些珍贵的东西，但不太知道那是什么。这是两人之间发展感情的故事。
